messages:
sam_release: Quick heads-up — we’re cutting v0.18.0 tomorrow at 18:00 PT. Need final changelog, version bump, SDK docs regen, and docsite deploy. Who can own the docs deploy and post-deploy smoke?

maria_docs: I can take docs deploy at ~18:10 PT. Important: SDK docs regen must be merged by 17:30 so the rendered snippets make it into the build. @alex_dev can you confirm PR status?

alex_dev: PR #912 (sdk-docs-regen) is open, one tiny typing fix left. CI is running; if green I can merge by 17:00. Command I used locally: `./scripts/regenerate-sdk-docs --sdk python,js`

liam_platform: Staging window confirmed 17:45–18:15. I’ll run the staging site cutover and smoke deploy preview. Maria, please give me the deploy artifact URL before 18:00.

amanda_qa: I’ll own the post-deploy smoke (console walkthrough + sample calls). Checklist: login, example generation, embeddings demo, billing page load. Can be ready 18:20 PT.

josh_engineer: Changelog note: I left a TODO under Breaking Changes → optimize batching. Will finish and push changelog bump by EOD. Also bumping go-client to v0.5.2 in the release PR.

deploy-bot: [bot] docs-regen CI started for PR #912 — 5 jobs queued. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/912

alex_dev: CI flaked on one matrix job, restarted. If it fails twice I’ll cut a hotfix patch for the snippet script.

maria_docs: Fallback: if regen doesn’t land, we can ship docs without updated SDK snippets and follow up with a patch release next week. Prefer to avoid that, but want everyone aware.

sam_release: Plan agreed: Alex land regen by 17:00; Liam trigger staging at 17:45; Maria deploy docs at 18:10; Amanda smoke at 18:20; I’ll cut the tag at 18:35. If anything blocks, post here and DM the release leads. :thumbsup:

josh_engineer: :thumbsup:

amanda_qa: +1 — I’ll post smoke checklist results in #eng-releases-staging once done.

liam_platform: Will be in #eng-staging during the window. Ping me for rollback quick steps.

sam_release: Thanks all — let’s keep this thread for quick status updates during the window. If someone needs help earlier, ping me or @maria_docs.
